verdict: A quiet day: mostly game-industry filler and low-signal model listings, with one incremental open-weight video model update worth a flag and nothing that lands in a pipeline this week.

stories.headline: LTX-2.5 video model updated on Hugging Face, now at 1.6M downloads
stories.body: Lightricks' LTX-2.5 image-to-video and text-to-video model has been updated on Hugging Face, gated under a custom non-commercial-style licence requiring terms acceptance. It now shows 1.6 million downloads and supports image-to-video, video-to-video, and audio-to-video tasks. No changelog or technical detail accompanies this update, so it's unclear what changed from the prior version.
stories.why: Worth monitoring as an open video model with broad task coverage, but licence terms need checking before any client use.
